page.content:
Robusta — stronger, more caffeinated species used in espresso blends and instant.

How Coffea canephora connects

  • Topic: Coffee — Robusta is the other commercial coffee species.
  • Item: Espresso — Many traditional espresso blends include robusta for crema and body.

What is Coffea canephora?

Coffea canephora (robusta) grows hotter and lower than arabica. Italian espresso often includes it for crema and punch; specialty culture usually sidelines it.

Key threads lead to Coffee and Espresso.
